<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=Italiana&display=swap');

      :root {
        --ink: #302a27;
        --ink-soft: #685f5a;
        --greige: #cdc6c3;
        --rose: #cfb3a9;
        --rose-deep: #9a7770;
        --dusty: #a09086;
        --cream: #e4d8cb;
        --paper: #fffcf8;
        --sage: #657267;
        --mist: #d9d5cf;
        --line: rgba(48, 42, 39, 0.16);
        --serif: 'Italiana', Georgia, serif;
        --sans: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
        --ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
      }

      * { box-sizing: border-box; }
      html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
      body {
        min-width: 320px;
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--paper);
        font-family: var(--sans);
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      }
      body.menu-open { overflow: hidden; }
      a { color: inherit; }
      button, a { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
      button { font: inherit; }
      img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }

      .skip-link {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 100;
        top: 0.75rem;
        left: 0.75rem;
        padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
        color: var(--paper);
        background: var(--ink);
        transform: translateY(-150%);
      }
      .skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0); }

      .hero {
        position: relative;
        display: grid;
        min-height: min(92svh, 58rem);
        isolation: isolate;
        overflow: hidden;
        color: var(--paper);
        background: #6f625c url('images/AuraBG.jpg') center 47% / cover no-repeat;
      }
      .hero::before {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: -1;
        inset: 0;
        content: '';
        background:
          linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(35, 29, 27, 0.76) 0%, rgba(35, 29, 27, 0.35) 52%, rgba(35, 29, 27, 0.08) 100%),
          linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(24, 19, 17, 0.28), transparent 36%, rgba(24, 19, 17, 0.42));
      }

      .site-header {
        align-self: start;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        width: min(100% - 2rem, 76rem);
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 0.9rem 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.34);
      }
      .brand {
        display: block;
        width: clamp(7rem, 12vw, 9rem);
        text-decoration: none;
      }
      .brand img {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        filter: brightness(0) invert(1);
      }
      .nav-toggle {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 30;
        display: grid;
        width: 2.8rem;
        height: 2.8rem;
        padding: 0;
        place-content: center;
        gap: 0.3rem;
        color: var(--paper);
        cursor: pointer;
        background: transparent;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.5);
      }
      .nav-toggle span {
        width: 1.15rem;
        height: 1px;
        background: currentColor;
        transition: transform 0.25s ease;
      }
      .nav-toggle[aria-expanded='true'] { color: var(--ink); }
      .nav-toggle[aria-expanded='true'] span:first-child { transform: translateY(0.2rem) rotate(45deg); }
      .nav-toggle[aria-expanded='true'] span:last-child { transform: translateY(-0.2rem) rotate(-45deg); }
      .site-nav {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 20;
        inset: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 1.4rem;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: rgba(247, 242, 236, 0.98);
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
      }
      .site-nav.is-open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
      .site-nav a {
        font-family: var(--serif);
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 9vw, 3.4rem);
        text-decoration: none;
      }

      .hero-inner {
        align-self: end;
        width: min(100% - 2rem, 76rem);
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: clamp(5rem, 12vh, 8rem) 0 clamp(3.5rem, 8vh, 5.5rem);
      }
      .kicker {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.7rem;
        margin: 0 0 1.1rem;
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.22em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      .kicker::before {
        width: 2.6rem;
        height: 1px;
        content: '';
        background: currentColor;
      }
      h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }
      h1 {
        max-width: 7ch;
        margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
        font-family: var(--serif);
        font-size: clamp(4.5rem, 15vw, 10rem);
        font-weight: 400;
        letter-spacing: 0;
        line-height: 0.82;
      }
      .hero-copy {
        max-width: 38rem;
        margin-bottom: 2rem;
        font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.22rem);
        line-height: 1.7;
        text-wrap: pretty;
      }
      .button-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.65rem; }
      .button {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 3.25rem;
        padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        text-decoration: none;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        transition: color 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s var(--ease);
      }
      .button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
      .button-primary { color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); }
      .button-secondary { color: var(--paper); border-color: rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.58); }

      .hero-actions {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.65rem;
        max-width: 47rem;
      }
      .hero-actions .button-primary {
        min-height: 3.8rem;
        padding-inline: 1.6rem;
      }
      .hero-action-links {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.65rem;
      }
      .location-line {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.65rem;
        margin: 0 0 1.4rem;
        color: rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.78);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      .location-line::before {
        width: 0.45rem;
        height: 0.45rem;
        content: '';
        border: 1px solid currentColor;
        transform: rotate(45deg);
      }

      main { overflow: hidden; }
      .section { padding: clamp(4.5rem, 9vw, 8.5rem) 0; }
      #welcome { padding-top: 2rem; }
      .wrap { width: min(100% - 2rem, 76rem); margin: 0 auto; }
      .section-label {
        margin-bottom: 1.3rem;
        color: var(--rose-deep);
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.2em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      .display-heading {
        max-width: 12ch;
        margin-bottom: 2rem;
        font-family: var(--serif);
        font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 5.8rem);
        font-weight: 400;
        letter-spacing: 0;
        line-height: 0.98;
        text-wrap: balance;
      }

      .welcome-layout { display: grid; gap: 2.5rem; }
      .welcome-copy {
        max-width: 43rem;
        color: var(--ink-soft);
        font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.4vw, 1.12rem);
        line-height: 1.85;
      }
      .welcome-copy p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
      .welcome-aside {
        align-self: end;
        padding: 1.7rem 0 0 1.5rem;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
      }
      .welcome-aside strong {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
        font-family: var(--serif);
        font-size: 2.2rem;
        font-weight: 400;
      }
      .welcome-aside span {
        color: var(--ink-soft);
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .experience { color: var(--cream); background: var(--ink); }
      .experience.section { padding: 0; }
      .experience .section-label { color: var(--rose); }
      .experience-layout {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        width: 100%;
      }
      .experience-copy {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        justify-content: center;
        max-width: none;
        padding: 4rem 1.25rem;
      }
      .experience-copy h2 { max-width: 12ch; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
      .experience-copy h3 {
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        font-family: var(--serif);
        font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
        font-weight: 400;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .experience-copy p {
        color: rgba(247, 242, 236, 0.74);
        font-size: 1rem;
        line-height: 1.8;
      }
      .ritual-note {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
        gap: 1rem;
        margin-top: 2rem;
        padding-top: 1.3rem;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(247, 242, 236, 0.2);
      }
      .ritual-number { color: var(--rose); font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 2.5rem; line-height: 1; }
      .ritual-note span:last-child {
        color: var(--cream);
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        line-height: 1.6;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      .experience-slider {
        position: relative;
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: clamp(22rem, 65vw, 34rem);
        overflow: hidden;
        background: #e7ded9;
      }
      .experience-slides { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      .experience-slide {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        margin: 0;
        opacity: 0;
        visibility: hidden;
        transition: opacity 0.55s ease, visibility 0.55s ease;
      }
      .experience-slide.is-active { z-index: 1; opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
      .experience-slide img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; object-position: center; }
      .experience-slide[data-image-align="right"] img { object-fit: cover; object-position: right center; }
      .experience-slide[data-image-align="left"] img { object-fit: cover; object-position: left center; }
      .experience-slider::after {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1;
        inset: 48% 0 0;
        content: "";
        pointer-events: none;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(25, 20, 18, 0.72));
      }
      .experience-slider-controls {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 2;
        right: 1.25rem;
        bottom: 1.25rem;
        left: 1.25rem;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.7rem;
      }
      .experience-slider-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; }
      .experience-slider button {
        min-width: 2.5rem;
        min-height: 2.5rem;
        padding: 0.45rem;
        color: #fff;
        cursor: pointer;
        background: rgba(48, 42, 39, 0.78);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.55);
        font: 600 0.75rem var(--sans);
      }
      .experience-slider button:hover { background: rgba(48, 42, 39, 0.96); }
      .experience-slider-dots {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 0.42rem;
      }
      .experience-slider .experience-slider-dot {
        min-width: 0.58rem;
        min-height: 0.58rem;
        width: 0.58rem;
        height: 0.58rem;
        padding: 0;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.35);
      }
      .experience-slider .experience-slider-dot[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #fff; }
      .experience-slider .experience-slider-toggle {
        min-width: 4.2rem;
        padding-inline: 0.7rem;
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      @media (min-width: 900px) {
        .experience-layout {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
          min-height: clamp(36rem, 76vh, 58rem);
        }
        .experience-copy { padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 7rem); }
        .experience-slider { min-height: 100%; }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .experience-slide { transition: none; }
      }

      .offerings { background: var(--paper); }
      .section-intro {
        max-width: 39rem;
        margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
        color: var(--ink-soft);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        line-height: 1.75;
      }
      .offer-grid { display: grid; gap: 0.85rem; }
      .offer {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        min-height: 30rem;
        padding: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
        flex-direction: column;
        isolation: isolate;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .offer::before,
      .offer::after {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: -1;
        content: '';
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .offer::before {
        right: -4rem;
        bottom: -7rem;
        width: 18rem;
        height: 28rem;
        border: 1px solid currentColor;
        opacity: 0.18;
        transform: rotate(28deg);
      }
      .offer::after {
        right: 2.5rem;
        bottom: 2.5rem;
        width: 5rem;
        height: 1px;
        background: currentColor;
        opacity: 0.28;
      }
      .offer--gift { color: var(--ink); background: var(--rose); }
      .offer--seasonal { color: var(--paper); background: var(--sage); }
      .offer--corporate { color: var(--ink); background: var(--greige); }
      .offer-topline {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 1rem;
        margin-bottom: auto;
        padding-bottom: 3rem;
        font-size: 0.64rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.14em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      .offer-index { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.4rem; }
      .offer h3 {
        max-width: 10ch;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        font-family: var(--serif);
        font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.2rem);
        font-weight: 400;
        line-height: 0.95;
      }
      .offer p {
        max-width: 34rem;
        margin-bottom: 1.35rem;
        color: currentColor;
        line-height: 1.7;
        opacity: 0.78;
      }
      .text-list {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.5rem 1.2rem;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
      }
      .text-list li {
        position: relative;
        padding-left: 0.9rem;
        color: currentColor;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        line-height: 1.5;
      }
      .text-list li::before {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0.55em;
        left: 0;
        width: 0.3rem;
        height: 0.3rem;
        content: '';
        background: currentColor;
        border-radius: 50%;
      }
      .offer-action {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 3.4rem;
        margin-top: 2rem;
        padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        text-decoration: none;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        border: 1px solid currentColor;
        transition: color 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
      }
      .offer-action span:last-child { font-size: 1.1rem; }
      .offer-action:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); }

      .events { position: relative; color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); }
      .events::before {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        right: 8%;
        width: min(32vw, 22rem);
        height: 1px;
        content: '';
        background: rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.5);
        transform: rotate(52deg);
        transform-origin: right;
      }
      .events .section-label, .events .section-intro { color: rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.76); }
      .events-layout { display: grid; gap: 2.5rem; }
      .event-list {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.28);
      }
      .event-list li {
        min-height: 6rem;
        padding: 1.1rem 0.6rem 1.1rem 0;
        font-family: var(--serif);
        font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 1.8rem);
        line-height: 1.1;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.28);
      }
      .event-list li:nth-child(odd) { padding-right: 1rem; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 252, 248, 0.28); }
      .event-list li:nth-child(even) { padding-left: 1rem; }

      .contact { text-align: center; background: var(--paper); }
      .contact .display-heading { max-width: 13ch; margin-right: auto; margin-left: auto; }
      .contact-copy {
        max-width: 36rem;
        margin: 0 auto 2rem;
        color: var(--ink-soft);
        line-height: 1.75;
      }
      .payment-details {
        width: min(100%, 36rem);
        margin: 0 auto 2rem;
        padding: 1.5rem;
        text-align: left;
        background: rgba(228, 216, 203, 0.54);
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
      }
      .payment-details h3 {
        margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
        font-family: var(--serif);
        font-size: 2rem;
        font-weight: 400;
      }
      .bank-details {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(7rem, auto) 1fr;
        gap: 0.65rem 1.25rem;
        margin: 0;
      }
      .bank-details dt {
        color: var(--ink-soft);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      .bank-details dd {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      .payment-note {
        margin: 1.25rem 0 0;
        padding-top: 1rem;
        color: var(--ink-soft);
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        line-height: 1.65;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      }
      .contact .button-primary { color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); }
      .contact .button-secondary { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--line); }
      .contact .button-row { justify-content: center; }

      .site-footer { color: var(--cream); background: var(--ink); }
      .footer-inner {
        display: grid;
        gap: 2rem;
        width: min(100% - 2rem, 76rem);
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 2.5rem 0;
      }
      .footer-brand { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 2.2rem; }
      .footer-details {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.65rem 1.4rem;
        color: rgba(247, 242, 236, 0.68);
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }
      .footer-details a { text-decoration-color: rgba(247, 242, 236, 0.34); text-underline-offset: 0.25rem; }
      .copyright { color: rgba(247, 242, 236, 0.48); font-size: 0.68rem; }

      .reveal {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(1.5rem);
        transition: opacity 0.8s var(--ease), transform 0.8s var(--ease);
      }
      .reveal.is-visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
      :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 4px; }

      @media (min-width: 720px) {
        .site-header, .hero-inner, .wrap, .footer-inner { width: min(100% - 4rem, 76rem); }
        .nav-toggle { display: none; }
        .site-nav {
          position: static;
          z-index: auto;
          flex-direction: row;
          gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
          color: var(--paper);
          background: transparent;
          opacity: 1;
          pointer-events: auto;
        }
        .site-nav a {
          font-family: var(--sans);
          font-size: 0.66rem;
          font-weight: 600;
          letter-spacing: 0.12em;
          text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .welcome-layout {
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.8fr) minmax(14rem, 0.8fr);
          gap: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 8rem);
        }
        .hero-actions { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: stretch; }
        .hero-action-links { align-items: stretch; }
        .offer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
        .offer--gift { min-height: 40rem; }
        .offer--seasonal { min-height: 40rem; transform: translateY(3.5rem); }
        .offer--corporate { grid-column: 1 / -1; min-height: 27rem; margin-top: 3.5rem; }
        .offer--corporate h3 { max-width: none; }
        .events-layout {
          grid-template-columns: minmax(15rem, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr);
          gap: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 9rem);
        }
        .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; }
        .footer-details { justify-content: center; }
      }

      @media (max-width: 719px) {
        .hero-action-links,
        .hero-actions .button { width: 100%; }
        .hero-action-links .button { flex: 1 1 100%; }
      }

      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        *, *::before, *::after {
          animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
          transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        }
        .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      }
</style>
<section class="section experience" id="experience" aria-labelledby="experience-heading">
        <div class="experience-layout">
          <div class="experience-copy">
            <p class="section-label">The Aura Experience</p>
            <h2 class="display-heading" id="experience-heading">Wellness begins with the senses.</h2>
            <h3>Sensory Wellness Therapy</h3>
            <p>Before your treatment begins, you’ll be invited to choose your preferred aroma from our signature collection of therapeutic oils. As calming fragrances fill the room, gentle touch, mindful rituals and a serene atmosphere work together to release tension, quiet the mind and restore balance.</p>
            <p>More than just a treatment, this is a complete sensory experience designed to nurture both body and soul, leaving you feeling renewed long after your visit.</p>
            <div class="ritual-note"><span class="ritual-number">01</span><span>Choose your aroma<br>Begin your ritual</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="experience-slider" data-experience-slider role="region" aria-label="Aura Spa photo slideshow">
            <div class="experience-slides">

      <script>
      (() => {
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-experience-slider]").forEach((slider) => {
          if (slider.dataset.initialized === "true") return;
          slider.dataset.initialized = "true";
          const slides = Array.from(slider.querySelectorAll("[data-slide]"));
          const dots = Array.from(slider.querySelectorAll("[data-slide-to]"));
          const toggle = slider.querySelector("[data-toggle]");
          const previous = slider.querySelector("[data-previous]");
          const next = slider.querySelector("[data-next]");
          let active = 0;
          let timer = null;
          let paused = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
          let hovering = false;
          let focused = false;

          function schedule() {
            window.clearInterval(timer);
            timer = null;
            if (!paused && !hovering && !focused && !document.hidden) {
              timer = window.setInterval(() => show(active + 1), 5000);
            }
          }

          function show(index) {
            active = (index + slides.length) % slides.length;
            slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
              const image = slide.querySelector("img");
              if (i === active && image.dataset.src) {
                image.src = image.dataset.src;
                image.removeAttribute("data-src");
              }
              slide.classList.toggle("is-active", i === active);
              slide.setAttribute("aria-hidden", String(i !== active));
              dots[i].setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(i === active));
            });
            schedule();
          }

          function updateToggle() {
            toggle.textContent = paused ? "Play" : "Pause";
            toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", paused ? "Play slideshow" : "Pause slideshow");
            toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(paused));
            schedule();
          }

          previous.addEventListener("click", () => show(active - 1));
          next.addEventListener("click", () => show(active + 1));
          dots.forEach((dot) => {
            dot.addEventListener("click", () => show(Number(dot.dataset.slideTo)));
          });
          toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
            paused = !paused;
            hovering = false;
            focused = false;
            updateToggle();
          });
          slider.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => { hovering = true; schedule(); });
          slider.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { hovering = false; schedule(); });
          slider.addEventListener("focusin", () => { focused = true; schedule(); });
          slider.addEventListener("focusout", (event) => {
            if (!slider.contains(event.relatedTarget)) {
              focused = false;
              schedule();
            }
          });
          document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", schedule);
          updateToggle();
          show(0);
        });
      })();
      </script>
